arguments.query:

FROM audit_logs
WHERE time BETWEEN '2022-07-20 00:51:30' AND '2022-07-20 00:55:30'
  AND (
    lower(coalesce(process_name,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
    OR lower(coalesce(pname,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
    OR lower(coalesce(object,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
    OR lower(coalesce(command_line,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'
    OR lower(coalesce(childproc_name,'')) LIKE '%powershell.exe%'

    event_id IN (1, 4688)

ORDER BY time, event_record_id, source_row_id
LIMIT 30;

arguments.query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, access, object, event_record_id, event_id, source_stream, source_row_id,
    subject_user_name, command_line, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line,
    process_guid, parent_process_guid, childproc_name, filemod_name, regmod_name, netconn_domain,
    remote_ip, remote_port, alert_name, alert_reason,
    CASE
      WHEN childproc_name IS NOT NULL OR parent_process_guid IN ('{558F98EB-5218-62D7-6601-000000003C00}','{558F98EB-521C-62D7-6801-000000003C00}') THEN 'child'
      WHEN filemod_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'file'
      WHEN regmod_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'registry'
      WHEN netconn_domain IS NOT NULL OR remote_ip IS NOT NULL OR remote_port IS NOT NULL OR access='connect' THEN 'network'
      WHEN alert_name IS NOT NULL OR alert_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'alert'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS category,
    COALESCE(childproc_name, filemod_name, regmod_name, netconn_domain, remote_ip || ':' || remote_port, object, alert_name, alert_reason, source_row_id, CAST(event_record_id AS TEXT)) AS target,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        CASE
          WHEN childproc_name IS NOT NULL OR parent_process_guid IN ('{558F98EB-5218-62D7-6601-000000003C00}','{558F98EB-521C-62D7-6801-000000003C00}') THEN 'child'
          WHEN filemod_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'file'
          WHEN regmod_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'registry'
          WHEN netconn_domain IS NOT NULL OR remote_ip IS NOT NULL OR remote_port IS NOT NULL OR access='connect' THEN 'network'
          WHEN alert_name IS NOT NULL OR alert_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'alert'
          ELSE 'other'
        END,
        COALESCE(childproc_name, filemod_name, regmod_name, netconn_domain, remote_ip || ':' || remote_port, object, alert_name, alert_reason, source_row_id, CAST(event_record_id AS TEXT))
      ORDER BY time, event_record_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE time BETWEEN '2022-07-20 00:53:44' AND '2022-07-20 00:56:30'
    AND (
      process_guid IN ('{558F98EB-5218-62D7-6601-000000003C00}','{558F98EB-521C-62D7-6801-000000003C00}')
      OR parent_process_guid IN ('{558F98EB-5218-62D7-6601-000000003C00}','{558F98EB-521C-62D7-6801-000000003C00}')
      OR pid IN (2976,3820)
      OR ppid IN (2976,3820)
    )
    AND (
      childproc_name IS NOT NULL OR filemod_name IS NOT NULL OR regmod_name IS NOT NULL
      OR netconn_domain IS NOT NULL OR remote_ip IS NOT NULL OR remote_port IS NOT NULL
      OR alert_name IS NOT NULL OR alert_reason IS NOT NULL OR access='connect'
    )
)

       process_guid, parent_process_guid, childproc_name, filemod_name, regmod_name, netconn_domain,

FROM base
WHERE rn=1
ORDER BY time, event_record_id
